note: DR figures are approximate (Ahrefs, mid-2026) and drift. Re-check before quoting. method: api | github-pr | github-issue | verify-deploy | form-anon | form-email | form-account | form-oauth | form-captcha | form-turnstile | paid | pitch | crawl. New directories are added here first; pooriaarab/directory-template data/directories.json is a synced copy.

web_tier1_launch.name: Product Hunt
web_tier1_launch.gate: Full launch ops; see product-hunt-launch skill. ~6 months between launches per product.

web_tier1_launch.name: BetaList
web_tier1_launch.gate: No free lane since 2026 (~$39 entry). Pre-launch or recently launched only.

web_tier1_startup.name: StartupStash
web_tier1_startup.gate: Curated; needs a real product page.

web_tier1_saas.name: AlternativeTo
web_tier1_saas.gate: List as an alternative to named competitors. Queue is months long.

web_tier1_saas.name: SaaSHub
web_tier1_saas.gate: Register, then submit. Free queue runs 1-2 months.

web_tier1_review.name: Capterra
web_tier1_review.gate: Gartner vendor onboarding (covers Capterra + GetApp + Software Advice). B2B software fit.

web_tier1_review.name: SourceForge
web_tier1_review.gate: Claim + complete the profile. Software fit.

web_tier1_review.name: G2
web_tier1_review.gate: Needs verified-user reviews for visibility. B2B software fit.

web_tier1_review.name: GetApp
web_tier1_review.gate: Same Gartner vendor flow as Capterra.

web_tier1_review.name: Software Advice
web_tier1_review.gate: Same Gartner vendor flow as Capterra.

web_ai_geo.name: There's An AI For That
web_ai_geo.gate: Real AI surface required. Free tier is slow.

web_longtail.name: Uneed
web_longtail.gate: Free waiting line: logo required before Schedule enables; join-waiting-line 429s after click bursts — space joins minutes apart. Free date queues ~13 months out. Free accounts hold ONE scheduled launch at a time (modal: upgrade to Pro for parallel launches) — one site per account, or pay.

web_longtail.name: Fazier
web_longtail.gate: Free launch gate: (1) post 3 approved comments on other products, (2) add product link, (3) embed the Fazier badge on the homepage — Verify Badge fetches the page. DR>0 required. OAuth popup needs a trusted click; email signup + Gmail verify link works.

web_longtail.name: Launched.io
web_longtail.gate: Fetch fails as of 2026-10; recheck before submitting.

web_longtail.name: MicroLaunch
web_longtail.gate: Paid-only as of 2026-11: launch dialog offers Pro $39 and Plus $79, no free tier. Skip unless a free queue returns.

web_longtail.name: ToolSalad
web_longtail.gate: Times out as of 2026-10; recheck before submitting.

web_curated.name: Curlie
web_curated.gate: Account + email verify confirmed working. Directory listing still needs a human volunteer-editor application — stop at the account.

web_llms_txt.name: llmstxt.site
web_llms_txt.gate: Site must serve /llms.txt; form asks a contact email.

web_llms_txt.name: llms-txt-hub
web_llms_txt.gate: PR adds one MDX under packages/content/data/websites/. Largest llms.txt registry.

web_llms_txt.name: llms.txt Directory (cloud)
web_llms_txt.gate: Confirmed: Turnstile passes unattended in a real browser profile (browser-personal). Fill URL+name+desc, wait for Success!, submit -> 'You're on the waitlist!'

web_engines.name: Internet Archive
web_engines.gate: GET /save/<url> anonymous; instant snapshot feeds the largest public crawl archive.

web_engines.name: Mojeek
web_engines.gate: Independent index; suggest a URL via their site contact; no public submit API.

web_engines.name: Wiby
web_engines.gate: Image CAPTCHA (securimage) defeats OCR at this distortion — ~1 in 12 reads landed. Fresh page load per attempt; reload-image desyncs; worksafe checkbox required. Budget real retry time or skip.

web_engines.name: Marginalia
web_engines.gate: Indie-web index; suggest through the site explorer.

web_engines.name: Entireweb
web_engines.gate: Free submission form; the site bot-blocks scripts, expect to do it by hand.

agent_submittable.name: submitby.ai
agent_submittable.gate: Confirmed end-to-end. POST /api/v1/submissions with Idempotency-Key header (platform value is 'web'). Save control_token. Deploy badge into server-rendered HTML, then POST /api/v1/submissions/:id/verify with Bearer token -> published in minutes.

agent_submittable.name: directree
agent_submittable.gate: Not a first-time submission path: agent API only updates already-claimed listings.

agent_submittable.name: justlaunch
agent_submittable.gate: REST API launch across ~35 platforms; per-launch pricing.

agent_submittable.name: Launch Llama
agent_submittable.gate: MCP tools open drafts + plan; the founder finishes on /submit.

agent_submittable.name: AI Directories
agent_submittable.gate: Partner API submits an AI tool to 30-100+ directories; issued key + fee. AI tools only.

mcp.name: Official MCP registry
mcp.gate: mcp-publisher + DNS TXT at the APEX (not _mcp): 'v=MCPv1; k=ed25519; p=<base64 pubkey>'. server.json description <=100 chars. Registry JWT expires fast; login then publish immediately.

mcp.name: mcp.tc
mcp.gate: Confirmed: POST {url,note} -> queued for review; slug reserved at /i/<slug>. marriagelicense.fyi listed live.

mcp.name: AllMCPs
mcp.gate: Confirmed: 3-step wizard (URL -> details -> Cloudflare Turnstile waits for Success! -> Submit to AllMCPs). Email confirmation per submission. Has a hosted-endpoint field; an 'agent prompt' on the page describes their MCP submission.

mcp.name: 402.ad
mcp.gate: $0.10 USDC via x402 for programmatic submit, or free form with questions.

mcp.name: mcp.so
mcp.gate: Confirmed: file one GitHub issue per server on chatmcp/mcpso. Open issues stay queued for human review.

mcp.name: awesome-remote-mcp-servers
mcp.submit: GitHub PR (add entry alphabetically in the right section)
mcp.gate: Confirmed PR path. Remote-only endpoints go to punkpeye's repo, not the installable-servers list.

mcp.name: Cline MCP Marketplace
mcp.gate: 400x400 PNG logo; quality-gated. Defer for new servers.

mcp.name: Glama
mcp.gate: Confirmed: GitHub OAuth in personal browser -> /mcp/servers -> Add Server -> 'Hosted endpoint' tab (NOT 'Runs from source'). 'Pending review' email per server = authoritative.

mcp.name: Smithery
mcp.gate: Confirmed: GitHub OAuth at smithery.ai/new -> slug + upstream URL -> step 2 click Skip with real mouse events (plain .click() does not register) -> lands on /servers/<ns>/<slug>/releases with SUCCESS.

mcp.name: FindMCP
mcp.gate: No public submit form found (Oct 2026); ingests the official registry — registry publish covers it.

mcp.name: MCP Hunt
mcp.gate: No public submit form found on the site; check for an auto-listing after registry publish.

mcp.name: mcp.directory
mcp.gate: Check for existing auto entry first.

mcp.name: PulseMCP
mcp.gate: Submissions paused; registry publish covers it.

agent_bot_platforms.name: Claude Connectors Directory
agent_bot_platforms.submit: Developer portal, Submit new > MCP connector
agent_bot_platforms.gate: Any paid Claude plan can submit a remote HTTPS MCP server; Anthropic reviews then lists a Community connector. Public docs link required by publish date; reviewers exercise every tool.

agent_bot_platforms.name: ChatGPT plugin directory
agent_bot_platforms.gate: Verified org + api.apps.write permission + public HTTPS MCP URL + CSP allow-list. Custom GPTs retire Dec 2026 — this is the live path.

agent_bot_platforms.name: cursor.directory
agent_bot_platforms.gate: GitHub/Google OAuth; name + description + install-instructions URL. A repo-root .mcp.json also powers the /plugins/new auto-detect path.

agent_bot_platforms.name: grokbots.best
agent_bot_platforms.gate: Asset-first: requires an existing https://x.ai/bot/... template link (create the Grok bot inside Grok, X Premium). 409 = already listed.

agent_bot_platforms.name: templatebot.lol
agent_bot_platforms.gate: Asset-first: requires an x.ai/bot share link; fetches name and description from x.ai.

agent_bot_platforms.name: grokbot.wtf
agent_bot_platforms.gate: Asset-first: x.ai/bot share link required. Fork, pnpm template:new, pnpm template:check, PR.

agent_bot_platforms.name: grok-bot.app
agent_bot_platforms.gate: Human editor review (PENDING_REVIEW). Accepts x.ai/bot links or a licensed GitHub PROFILE.

agent_bot_platforms.name: Poe
agent_bot_platforms.gate: Poe account; a prompt bot pointing at the site or its /mcp publishes immediately at poe.com/<handle> — no review for basic bots.
